cross_split_checks.hash_method: pandas hash_pandas_object over source string fields; interpreted as a duplicate-screening check

duplicate_aware_validation.class_balance: use fixed-seed group-aware stratification if available and report resulting class counts because repeated groups constrain exact stratification
duplicate_aware_validation.official_test: keep the official test split untouched for final evaluation after model selection
duplicate_aware_validation.secondary_test_slice: report a secondary result for test rows whose predictor-vector hash was not observed in the full official training split
duplicate_aware_validation.validation_partition: split official training rows by groups formed from the 42 predictor values; keep each repeated predictor vector on one side only

processing_log: 1. Read-only source audit: opened the prepared CSVs under data/raw; source bytes were not changed.
2. Integrity: computed SHA-256 in 1 MiB chunks and compared digest, byte size, and row count to the acquisition record.
3. Parsing: read as strings with keep_default_na=False and na_filter=False to preserve empty cells and literal text.
4. Profiling: counted empty/whitespace/blank-like cells, distinct and frequent values, and numeric ranges/quantiles; numeric coercion was temporary and diagnostic only.
5. Target audit: counted label values and cross-tabulated attack_cat against label; label is y and attack_cat is excluded as target-derived.
6. Split screen: omitted id, label, and attack_cat from candidate predictors; hashed full rows and predictor-only rows to screen overlap.
7. Reporting: generated derived JSON and Markdown outputs; this audit did not train a model.

source_and_scope.feature_grain: one prepared dataset row, intended to represent one network flow record
